prompt: A city health department wants to cut average ER waiting times across its four hospitals. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Hospital A has the shortest wait
options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: All four hospitals have similar waits
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: C waits 120 minutes; the others 45–50.

options.text: Hospital C's wait is far longer than the others'
options.feedback: Right. C averages 120 minutes against 45–50 at A, B and D.

options.text: Hospital C is understaffed, which is why its patients wait so long
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

explanation: Hospital C's wait is far longer than the others'. C averages 120 minutes against 45–50 at A, B and D.

extras.proof: C averages 120 minutes against 45–50 at A, B and D.
